description: Comprehensive EDS migration blueprint for juvederm.nl — single source of truth for Block Developer and Page Migrator agents.

site.sourceFramework: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) with AbbVie Aesthetics component library (aaaem-*)

archetypes.name: homepage
archetypes.description: Main landing page showcasing JUVÉDERM brand, benefits, before/after results, and treatment zones.

extraction.instructions: Extract the H1 heading text, background image URL (from dm-aid src), and video mp4 URL. The image serves as the poster/fallback for the video.
Extract intro paragraph text for column 1. Extract the paired image URL for column 2. Preserve any CTA button links within the text.

extraction.source: aaaem-card (x4) inside container with 'card' style class
extraction.instructions: Extract 4 cards. For each card: title text (bold) and body paragraph text. No images or CTAs on these cards.
Extract small-print disclaimer/footnote text. Render as paragraph with <small> tags or fine-print class.

Extract 5 unique slide pairs (ignore mobile/desktop duplicates). Each slide: 'Voor' label + before image URL, 'Na' label + after image URL. Ensure image URLs are de-duplicated from the 10 source items.

Extract: (1) main portrait image URL, (2) for each of 4 zones: label text, description paragraph, optional zone-specific image URL. Zones: Versterk contouren, Stralende oogopslag, Herstel volume, Vollere lippen.
Extract video embed URL if present. If container is client-side rendered with no static content, create a CTA section linking to /nl/find-a-clinic instead.
Extract medical reference/footnote text. Render as small-print paragraph.

archetypes.name: treatment
archetypes.description: Treatment detail pages for specific facial areas (lips, eyes, enhance, restore, male). Includes hero, intro, benefits, before/after, products, FAQ, and treatment zones.

extraction.instructions: Extract the H1 heading text and background image URL. No video on treatment pages.
Extract intro paragraph text for column 1, paired image for column 2. Include any CTA buttons.
Extract 3 unique benefit text paragraphs (ignore mobile/desktop duplicates from 6 source items). Each slide is a single paragraph.
Extract: column 1 = 'Voor' label + before image URL, column 2 = 'Na' label + after image URL.
Extract 5 unique product cards (ignore duplicates from 10 source items). Each card: product title, body text, background image URL.

Extract 4 Q&A pairs. Each: question text (accordion header) and answer text (accordion body). Note: an image may sit adjacent to the accordion in the same section — extract it as a separate image element before the accordion block.
Same extraction as homepage. This is a shared experience fragment — content is identical. Extract portrait image + 4 zone definitions.
Extract video embed URL or create CTA section for clinic finder.
Extract medical reference/footnote text as small-print paragraph.

archetypes.name: faq
archetypes.description: FAQ/Q&A page with topic navigation, sectioned content about JUVÉDERM, fillers, treatments, costs, and results.

extraction.instructions: Extract H1 heading ('Ontdek het antwoord op je vraag') and background image URL.

Extract anchor link items. Each item: label text + anchor href. Links: Over Juvéderm® → #about-juvederm, Kosten → #duration, Langdurige resultaten → #results, Veiligheid → #side-effects, Zones van het gezicht → #facial-areas.
Extract headings ('Wat is JUVÉDERM®?', etc.), paragraph text blocks, and images. Add id='about-juvederm' to section for anchor navigation. Use --- section separators between topic groups.
Extract 3 unique text slides (from 6 source items): Langdurige resultaten, Een uniek behandelplan, Hoge kwaliteit.

extraction.source: Multiple section containers with FAQ topic groups
extraction.instructions: Extract ~30+ text blocks and ~8 images organized by topic. Each topic group becomes an EDS section (--- separator). Add anchor IDs for navigation: #duration, #results, #side-effects, #facial-areas. Topic groups: Wat zijn fillers?, Wat is hyaluronzuur?, Hoe werken fillers?, Behandeling voorbereiding, Bijwerkingen, Behandelingsduur en pijn, Kosten, Resultaatduur, Zones van het gezicht.
Extract reference footnotes as small-print paragraph.

archetypes.name: locator
archetypes.description: Clinic finder pages with search interface for finding JUVÉDERM treatment providers by location.

extraction.instructions: Extract H1 heading ('Vind een kliniek bij jou in de buurt') and background image URL.

Extract heading text ('Zoek op plaatsnaam'), input placeholder text ('Zoek op postcode, plaatsnaam'), and results page URL (/nl/clinics). Google Places API key should be configured externally, not embedded in content.
Extract medical reference footnotes.

archetypes.name: legal
archetypes.description: Legal/disclaimer pages with long-form text content only.

pages.title: General Terms and Conditions Clinic Finder | Juvéderm® Netherlands

extraction.instructions: Extract center-aligned heading, then all body paragraphs and links. Pure text content — no blocks needed. Preserve all paragraph text, links, and any list structures.

archetypes.name: contact
archetypes.description: Simple contact information page with company address, phone, and email.

extraction.instructions: Extract center-aligned heading ('NEEM CONTACT OP'), company address paragraph, phone and email links. Pure text — no blocks needed.

contentModel.description: Full-width hero banner with background media and heading overlay. Authors create a table with header row 'Hero' (or 'Hero (hero-video)' for video variant).

rows.label: Image
cells: Background image — drag-and-drop image into cell

rows.label: Video (optional)
cells: Link to mp4 video file (hero-video variant only)

variants.name: hero-video
variants.description: Hero with looping background video + image poster/fallback. Used on homepage.

variants.name: hero-image
variants.description: Hero with background image only. Used on treatment, faq, locator pages.

implementation.jsNotes: Decorate function: wrap image as background (position absolute, object-fit cover), overlay heading with semi-transparent gradient. For video variant, create <video autoplay muted loop playsinline> with image as poster. Use IntersectionObserver for lazy video loading.
implementation.cssNotes: Full-width (100vw), min-height 60vh on desktop / 40vh on mobile. Heading: white text, large font, positioned over gradient overlay.

contentModel.description: Sliding carousel with dot indicators. Each row in the table is one slide. Table header specifies variant.

rows.label: Slide
cells: Slide content varies by variant — see variant definitions

variants.name: before-after
variants.description: Two images per slide with Voor/Na labels. Used on homepage.
variants.rowStructure: Cell 1: 'Voor' text + before image | Cell 2: 'Na' text + after image

variants.name: text-only
variants.description: Single paragraph text per slide. Used on treatment and faq pages.
variants.rowStructure: Cell 1: Paragraph text for the slide

variants.name: product-cards
variants.description: Card per slide with background image, title, description. Used on treatment pages.
variants.rowStructure: Cell 1: Product image | Cell 2: Product title (bold) + body text

implementation.jsNotes: Build slide container with transform-based horizontal scrolling. Add dot indicators. Support touch/swipe via pointer events. Auto-advance optional. De-duplicate slides (source has mobile/desktop copies).
implementation.cssNotes: Overflow hidden on container. Slides flex in row. Dot indicators centered below. Transitions via CSS transform with 300ms ease.

contentModel.description: Grid of cards. Each row defines one card.

variants.name: text-only
variants.description: No images, title + body text only. 4 cards in horizontal row. Used on homepage.

variants.name: product
variants.description: Background image + title + description. Used on treatment pages (often inside carousel).

implementation.jsNotes: Simple DOM restructuring: each row becomes a card div. Text-only variant: flex row with equal-width cards. Product variant: image as background with text overlay.
implementation.cssNotes: Cards container: display flex, gap, wrap. Each card: padding, border-radius. Text-only: white background, centered text. Product: relative positioned with background-image cover.

contentModel.description: Expandable/collapsible FAQ pairs. Each row is one Q&A item.

implementation.jsNotes: Wrap each row in a details/summary HTML element OR custom div with aria-expanded. Toggle answer visibility on click. Add +/- or chevron icon via CSS pseudo-element.
implementation.cssNotes: Question: bold, pointer cursor, padding, border-bottom. Answer: hidden by default, smooth max-height transition. Icon rotates on expand.

contentModel.description: Two-column layout for text + image side-by-side. Uses EDS boilerplate columns block.

rows.label: Content
cells: Cell 1: Text content (heading + paragraph + optional CTA)

variants.name: before-after
variants.description: Two images side-by-side with Voor/Na labels. Used on treatment pages.
variants.rowStructure: Cell 1: 'Voor' label + before image | Cell 2: 'Na' label + after image

variants.name: text-image
variants.description: Text on left, image on right. Used for intro sections.
variants.rowStructure: Cell 1: Heading + paragraph + CTA | Cell 2: Image

implementation.jsNotes: Standard EDS boilerplate columns block. Minimal or no JS customization needed.
implementation.cssNotes: Uses boilerplate CSS. May need minor overrides for Juvéderm brand spacing and before-after label styling.

contentModel.description: Interactive face portrait with toggling text panels for treatment zones.

rows.label: Portrait Image
cells: Main face/portrait image shared across all zones

implementation.jsNotes: Build tab-like interface: zone labels as clickable buttons, description panels shown/hidden on click. Portrait image displayed alongside or behind zone content. Use aria-selected and aria-hidden for accessibility. First zone active by default.
implementation.cssNotes: Two-column layout: portrait image on one side, zone selector + description on the other. Zone buttons: inline or stacked. Active zone highlighted with brand color. Smooth transition on panel switch. Responsive: stack vertically on mobile.

contentModel.description: Sticky anchor navigation for FAQ page sections.

rows.label: Topic Link
cells: Cell 1: Link text (topic label, e.g., 'Over Juvéderm®')

implementation.jsNotes: Render anchor links as horizontal scrollable nav. Add smooth-scroll behavior on click. Use IntersectionObserver on target sections to highlight active topic. Sticky positioning via CSS.
implementation.cssNotes: Position sticky, top 0, z-index above content. Horizontal flex with overflow-x auto on mobile. Active link: underline or brand-color highlight. Background with subtle shadow for separation.

contentModel.description: Clinic finder search interface with Google Places autocomplete.

rows.label: Config
cells: Cell 2: Input placeholder text (e.g., 'Zoek op postcode, plaatsnaam')

rows.label: Settings
cells: Cell 1: Google Places API key or config sheet URL

implementation.jsNotes: Dynamically load Google Places JS API. Create search input with autocomplete restricted to NL. On place selection or form submit, redirect to results page with lat/lng or place_id query params. Handle geolocation fallback. Most complex custom block.
implementation.cssNotes: Search container: centered, max-width, padding. Input: full-width with icon. Submit button: brand primary style. Google Places dropdown: style overrides for pac-container to match brand.

variants.name: tracking
variants.description: Third-party tracking script. May not need migration — evaluate replacing with EDS-native analytics.

implementation.jsNotes: Detect URL type: if video (mp4/youtube/vimeo), create appropriate player element. If third-party embed, create iframe. Lazy-load via IntersectionObserver.
implementation.cssNotes: Responsive container with 16:9 aspect ratio for video. Max-width constrained. Centered in section.

defaultContent.description: Source AEM components that map to plain EDS default content (standard HTML elements). No custom blocks required — aem.js handles rendering automatically.

mappings.extractionInstructions: Copy paragraph text directly. Footnotes/references: wrap in section with 'footer-notes' style. Preserve bold, italic, links. Superscript reference numbers should use <sup> tags.
mappings.notes: Most common component (5–30+ per page). Includes body copy, footnotes, disclaimers, references.

mappings.extractionInstructions: Map heading levels directly (h1, h2, h3, etc.). For center-aligned headings, place in a section with 'centered' section style metadata.
mappings.notes: Source supports alignment variants. H1 is typically inside hero block, H2 for section headings, H3-H4 for subsections.

mappings.extractionInstructions: Download image from Dynamic Media URL. Upload to DA.live content source. Insert as standard image in document. Include alt text. If image has a link wrapper, preserve the link.
mappings.notes: Source uses Adobe Dynamic Media (dm-aid--{uuid}) URLs with lazy loading. EDS uses standard <picture> with srcset.

mappings.edsElement: <a> styled as button (bold link = button in EDS)
mappings.extractionInstructions: Create a link in the document. For primary buttons, make the link bold and it renders as a button. For secondary/outline variants, use em (italic) wrapping. Button text and href must be preserved.

buttonVariantMapping.primary-filled: Bold link — renders as .button.primary (coral/pink background, white text)
buttonVariantMapping.primary-outline: Bold + italic link — renders as .button.secondary (outlined, coral/pink border)
buttonVariantMapping.secondary-filled: Bold link in dark section — renders with dark styling

mappings.notes: Three visual styles in source. EDS button styling defined in styles/styles.css.

mappings.extractionInstructions: AEM containers become EDS section separators (---). Apply section style metadata where needed (scroll-reveal, centered, footer-notes). Ignore purely structural containers that have no visual impact.
mappings.notes: Not all AEM containers need explicit migration. Many are structural wrappers.

nav.description: Header navigation auto-generated from /nav document in DA.live content source.

mobileNav.behavior: Toggles full-screen overlay with same menu items. Handled by EDS header block JS.

footer.description: Footer auto-generated from /footer document in DA.live content source.

buttonStyles.name: primary-filled
buttonStyles.css: background: coral/pink (#E4717A approx); color: white; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600;

buttonStyles.name: primary-outline
buttonStyles.css: background: transparent; border: 2px solid coral/pink; color: coral/pink; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 24px;
buttonStyles.edsMapping: Bold+italic link in document → <a class='button secondary'>

buttonStyles.name: secondary-filled
buttonStyles.css: background: dark (#333 approx); color: white; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 24px;
buttonStyles.edsMapping: Context-dependent button styling via section or block variant

sectionStyles.name: scroll-reveal
sectionStyles.description: Scroll-triggered reveal animation. Content fades/slides in when scrolled into viewport.
sectionStyles.implementation: Add 'scroll-reveal' to Section Metadata Style field. CSS: initial opacity 0, transform translateY(20px). JS: IntersectionObserver adds '.revealed' class. Transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease.

sectionStyles.name: centered
sectionStyles.description: Center-aligned text content for legal and contact pages.
sectionStyles.implementation: Add 'centered' to Section Metadata Style field. CSS: text-align center on all direct children.

sectionStyles.name: footer-notes
sectionStyles.description: Small-print reference/footnote styling at bottom of content sections.
sectionStyles.implementation: Add 'footer-notes' to Section Metadata Style field. CSS: font-size 0.75rem, color #666, line-height 1.4.

colorScheme.description: Warm tones with pink/coral accents — Juvéderm brand palette

headingLevels.h1: Hero headings only — large display, white on image
